data.name: Major Aspect of the Tiger
data.description: Your shape changes to that of a dire tiger (Bestiary p265). While in this form, you gain a base speed of 40 feet, low-light vision, scent (30 feet), two claw attacks (2d4 damage), a bite attack (2d6 damage), the grab ability with both your bite and claw attacks, and pounce.

raw_tokens.value: Your shape changes to that of a dire tiger (Bestiary p265). While in this form, you gain a base speed of 40 feet, low-light vision, scent (30 feet), two claw attacks (2d4 damage), a bite attack (2d6 damage), the grab ability with both your bite and claw attacks, and pounce.
You gain a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks.|PREVARGTEQ:ShifterTigerAspectLVL,8
You gain the rake attack with your back claw attacks (dealing additional damage equal to that of your claw attack).|PREVARGTEQ:ShifterTigerAspectLVL,15
